title: Clinical Applications and Outcomes of Static-guided Endodontics in Teeth with Pulp Canal Obliteration: A Scoping Review
html: Pulp canal obliteration presents a significant challenge in endodontic practice because canal location and negotiation may be difficult and associated with an increased risk of procedural errors. Static-guided endodontics combines cone-beam computed tomography, digital surface scanning, and three-dimensional printing to facilitate guided access to calcified canals. This scoping review aimed to map and summarize the available clinical evidence regarding the use of static-guided endodontics in the management of pulp canal obliteration.
